api_key.description: Pinecone API Key. Can be configured by setting PINECONE_API_KEY environment variable.

client_id.description: Pinecone Client ID for admin operations. Can be configured by setting PINECONE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

client_secret.description: Pinecone Client Secret for admin operations. Can be configured by setting PINECONE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.

block.description:
You can use the this Terraform provider to manage resources supported 
by [Pinecone](https://www.pinecone.io/). The provider must be configured with the proper 
credentials before use. You can provide credentials via the PINECONE_API_KEY environment variable.

name.description: The name of the API key to be created. Must be 1-80 characters long.

project_id.description: The project ID where the API key will be created. Required for creation, optional for updates.

roles.description: The roles assigned to the API key. Valid values are: ProjectEditor, ProjectViewer, ControlPlaneEditor, ControlPlaneViewer, DataPlaneEditor, DataPlaneViewer. Defaults to ["ProjectEditor"].

block.description: The `pinecone_api_key` resource lets you create and manage API keys in Pinecone. Learn more about API keys in the [docs](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/authentication/api-keys).

dimension.description: The dimension of the vectors stored in each record held in the collection.

environment.description: The environment where the collection is hosted.

size.description: The size of the collection in bytes.

source.description: The name of the source index to be used as the source for the collection.

vector_count.description: The number of records stored in the collection.

create.description: Timeout defaults to 5 mins. Accepts a string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

delete.description: Timeout defaults to 5 mins. Accepts a string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

block.description: The `pinecone_collection` resource lets you create and manage collections in Pinecone. Learn more about collections in the [docs](hhttps://docs.pinecone.io/guides/indexes/understanding-collections).

deletion_protection.description: Whether deletion protection for the index is enabled. You can use 'enabled', or 'disabled'.

dimension.description: The dimensions of the vectors to be inserted in the index. Required for pod-based and non-integrated serverless indexes. For integrated indexes with an embed model, this is optional and will default to the model's dimension if not specified.
The dimension of the embedding model, specifying the size of the output vector.

effective_read_parameters.description: The effective read parameters as returned by the API after apply, including any server-injected defaults not present in `read_parameters`.

effective_write_parameters.description: The effective write parameters as returned by the API after apply, including any server-injected defaults not present in `write_parameters`.

field_map.description: Identifies the name of the text field from your document model that will be embedded.

metric.description: The distance metric to be used for similarity search. You can use 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'dotproduct'. If the 'vector_type' is 'sparse', the metric must be 'dotproduct'. If the vector_type is dense, the metric defaults to 'cosine'.

model.description: the name of the embedding model to use for the index.

read_parameters.description: The read parameters for the embedding model.

vector_type.description: The index vector type associated with the model. If 'dense', the vector dimension must be specified. If 'sparse', the vector dimension will be nil.

write_parameters.description: The write parameters for the embedding model.

embed.description:
Specify the integrated inference embedding configuration for the index. Once set, the model cannot be changed. However, you can later update the embedding configuration—including field map, read parameters, and write parameters.

Refer to the [model guide](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/inference/understanding-inference#embedding-models) for available models and details.

host.description: The URL address where the index is hosted.

metric.description: The distance metric to be used for similarity search. You can use 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'dotproduct'. If the 'vector_type' is 'sparse', the metric must be 'dotproduct'. If the vector_type is dense, the metric defaults to 'cosine'.

name.description: The name of the index to be created. The maximum length is 45 characters.

environment.description: The environment identifier for the BYOC index.

node_type.description: The type of machines to use. Available options: 'b1' and 't1'.

dedicated.description: Dedicated read capacity mode. Set `node_type`, `replicas`, and `shards` to provision fixed compute for this index. All three fields are required when first switching to dedicated mode.

on_demand.description: OnDemand read capacity mode (the default). Specify this block (even empty) to explicitly select OnDemand or to switch back from dedicated mode.

read_capacity.description: Read capacity configuration for the index. Set exactly one of `dedicated` or `on_demand` to select the mode. Omitting `read_capacity` entirely on create defaults to OnDemand. To switch modes after creation, explicitly set the desired sub-block — removing `read_capacity` from config will not change the mode already recorded in state.

filterable.description: Whether the field is filterable. Only true is currently supported.

fields.description: Map of metadata field names to their schema configuration. Only fields with `filterable: true` are indexed.

schema.description: Schema for the behavior of Pinecone's internal metadata index. By default, all metadata is indexed; when `schema` is present, only fields listed in `fields` with `filterable: true` are indexed. This field can only be set at index creation time — changing it requires replacing the index.

byoc.description: Configuration needed to deploy a BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) index.

environment.description: The environment where the index is hosted.

metadata_config.description: Configuration for the behavior of Pinecone's internal metadata index. By default, all metadata is indexed; when metadata_config is present, only specified metadata fields are indexed. These configurations are only valid for use with pod-based indexes.

pod_type.description: The type of pod to use. One of s1, p1, or p2 appended with . and one of x1, x2, x4, or x8.

pods.description: The number of pods to be used in the index. This should be equal to shards x replicas.'

replicas.description: The number of replicas. Replicas duplicate your index. They provide higher availability and throughput. Replicas can be scaled up or down as your needs change.

shards.description: The number of shards. Shards split your data across multiple pods so you can fit more data into an index.

source_collection.description: The name of the collection to create an index from.

pod.description: Configuration needed to deploy a pod-based index.

cloud.description: The public cloud where you would like your index hosted. [gcp|aws|azure]

node_type.description: The type of machines to use. Available options: 'b1' and 't1'.

dedicated.description: Dedicated read capacity mode. Set `node_type`, `replicas`, and `shards` to provision fixed compute for this index. All three fields are required when first switching to dedicated mode.

on_demand.description: OnDemand read capacity mode (the default). Specify this block (even empty) to explicitly select OnDemand or to switch back from dedicated mode.

read_capacity.description: Read capacity configuration for the index. Set exactly one of `dedicated` or `on_demand` to select the mode. Omitting `read_capacity` entirely on create defaults to OnDemand. To switch modes after creation, explicitly set the desired sub-block — removing `read_capacity` from config will not change the mode already recorded in state.

region.description: The region where you would like your index to be created.

fields.description: Map of metadata field names to their schema configuration. Only fields with `filterable: true` are indexed.

state.description: Initializing InitializationFailed ScalingUp ScalingDown ScalingUpPodSize ScalingDownPodSize Upgrading Terminating Ready

tags.description: Custom user tags added to an index. Keys must be 80 characters or less. Values must be 120 characters or less. Keys must be alphanumeric, '', or '-'. Values must be alphanumeric, ';', '@', '', '-', '.', '+', or ' '. To unset a key, set the value to be an empty string.

vector_type.description: The index vector type. You can use 'dense' or 'sparse'. If 'dense', the vector dimension must be specified. If 'sparse', the vector dimension should not be specified.

create.description: Timeout defaults to 5 mins. Accepts a string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

delete.description: Timeout defaults to 5 mins. Accepts a string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

block.description: The `pinecone_index` resource lets you create and manage indexes in Pinecone. Learn more about indexes in the [docs](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/indexes/understanding-indexes).

created_at.description: The timestamp when the project was created.

force_encryption_with_cmek.description: Whether to force encryption with a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK). Default is `false`. Once enabled, CMEK encryption cannot be disabled.

max_pods.description: The maximum number of Pods that can be created in the project. Default is `0` (serverless only).

name.description: The name of the project to be created.

organization_id.description: The organization ID where the project will be created.
